description: Run one or more tested library tools on this dataset, with charts and a written report. No custom build. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

inputSchema.description:
One or more tested library tools on this dataset. One tool runs directly; several run as a library-only package
(no custom build: that is path_bespoke).

column_mapping.description: dataset column for each input the tool needs; absent = suggested from the data
column_mapping.title: Column Mapping

dataset_ref.description: the dataset: a uuid://, upload:// or dataset id the caller owns
dataset_ref.title: Dataset Ref

idempotency_key.description: send one per run; a retry with the same key replays the first call instead of running it again
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

objective.description: the question, in the person's words
objective.title: Objective

resolution_id.description: The resolution_id from path_resolver's path_input. Pass path_input as given.
